title: Lesson 2 stuck locked, and a silent-do-nothing Conversation chip
changes: Fixed lesson 2 (and beyond) staying greyed out after finishing lesson 1. journey.js had its own fallback for "which chapter is current" that checked a p.reps progress field that isn't part of the real data model, so it under-counted introduced words and could get stuck. It now defers to the app's own authoritative currentWordChapterIndex() instead of maintaining a second, drifting implementation.

Fixed the session-preview "Conversation · <title>" chip sometimes doing nothing when tapped. It was matched purely by whether the conversation used one of the session's words, with no check for whether that conversation was actually unlocked yet — so a locked conversation could be offered as a clickable option that silently no-opped when tapped. It now only offers conversations that are actually unlocked.
